title: Peaceful Nashville Getaway - Great Outdoor Space!
description:
Our place is tucked away in the hills on a beautiful property just 20 minutes north of Nashville! The 4 bed, 2 bath residence makes it the perfect getaway for family and friends alike looking for a comfortable space that's convenient to many local Nashville attractions. It has a great backyard space and firepit with an outdoor TV and a rock wall view that will make you feel like you are in the mountains as you sip your morning coffee.

The space
The space is private and has the scenic mountain view while still being close to the city of Nashville. It is also within 10 minutes of restaurants, grocery stores, etc.

Other things to note
plenty of parking space
